package handler

import (
	db "example.com/card-rpg-practice/db"
	runentity "example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/entities/card_run"
	"example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/modules/cardrpg"
	"example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/view"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

// 卡牌的 Player 参数是实体总接口 view.PlayerEntity：同一笔事务里要用 wallet（金币）、bag（钻石、尘、英雄道具）、
// stamina（体力）、gacha（抽卡）与 task（任务事件）几个模块组件，卡牌自己的存档在 PlayerDao.State。
type ICardRunEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.CardRunDao
	TimerComp() *runentity.TimerComponent
}

// CardWonEvent 是胜利领奖时上报给 task 的事件名；任务表里 event 列等于它的任务（缺省“首胜”）随之推进。
const CardWonEvent = "card.won"

// cardView 是玩家视图：卡牌存档裁剪后的部分加上模块状态里的资产。体力取这条消息冻结的业务时间那一刻的值。
func cardView(player view.PlayerEntity, p cardrpg.Profile, nowUnixMilli int64) cardrpg.ProfileView {
	v := p.View()
	v.Gold = player.Wallet().Balance()
	v.Gems = player.Bag().Count(cardrpg.ItemGems)
	v.Dust = player.Bag().Count(cardrpg.ItemDust)
	v.Energy = player.Stamina().Current(nowUnixMilli)
	return v
}

// applyEffects 把养成 / 扫荡的资产增减交给模块：先扣（体力、金币、尘），再发。任何一步被拒（stamina_short、
// wallet_short、bag_short……）原样返回，Nest 把卡牌状态与已做的模块写入一起回滚。
func applyEffects(player view.PlayerEntity, e cardrpg.Effects, nowUnixMilli int64) error {
	if e.Energy > 0 {
		if _, err := player.Stamina().Spend(e.Energy, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if e.Gold != 0 {
		if _, err := player.Wallet().Add(e.Gold); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if e.Dust < 0 {
		if _, err := player.Bag().Remove(cardrpg.ItemDust, -e.Dust); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if e.Dust > 0 {
		if _, err := player.Bag().Add(cardrpg.ItemDust, e.Dust); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// 抽卡交给 gacha：扣金币、按卡池权重与保底抽样、发英雄道具、记回执都在 Gacha().Draw 里；本 handler 在同一笔事务里
// 把发进背包的英雄道具取出，换成卡牌实例，重复卡转碎片并得 1 尘。gacha 的重放（Replayed）什么都没写，这里也不再转换。
// 失败的尝试（余额不足、背包满、转换被拒、提交失败）整笔回滚，没有持久结果；重试会重新抽样，成功结果由回执固定。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardDraw(player view.PlayerEntity, key string, count int) (cardrpg.DrawReceipt, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
	}
	r, err := player.Gacha().Draw(key, cardrpg.DrawPool, int64(count))
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
	}
	receipt := cardrpg.DrawReceipt{Key: key, Count: count, Cost: r.Cost, Balance: r.Balance, Misses: r.Misses}
	for _, item := range r.Items {
		template, ok := cardrpg.HeroTemplate(item)
		if !ok {
			return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		receipt.Templates = append(receipt.Templates, template)
	}
	if r.Replayed {
		return receipt, nil
	}
	for _, item := range r.Items {
		if _, err := player.Bag().Remove(item, 1); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
		}
		_, duplicate, err := p.Collect(item)
		if err != nil {
			return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
		}
		if duplicate {
			if _, err := player.Bag().Add(cardrpg.ItemDust, 1); err != nil {
				return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
			}
		}
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return receipt, nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardManage(player view.PlayerEntity, command cardrpg.Manage, rules cardrpg.Rules, nowUnixMilli int64) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	effects, err := p.Manage(command, rules)
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	if err := applyEffects(player, effects, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return cardView(player, p, nowUnixMilli), nil
}

// 体力（stamina）、开局顺序身份、冻结的编队和 Run 一起提交。Player 保持静态 sid，Run 由同一原服承载。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardStart(player view.PlayerEntity, run ICardRunEntity, seq uint64, stage int, rules cardrpg.Rules, nowUnixMilli int64) (int64, error) {
	if !entity.MatchEntityID(run.ID(), runentity.EntityKindCardRun) || !cardrpg.ValidTime(nowUnixMilli) {
		return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if seq > 0 && seq <= uint64(len(p.Runs)) {
		old := p.Runs[seq-1]
		if old.Stage != stage {
			return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		return old.RunID, nil
	}
	if seq == 0 || seq != uint64(len(p.Runs))+1 || len(p.Runs) >= cardrpg.LedgerLimit || p.ActiveRun != 0 || stage < 1 || stage > 3 || stage > 1 && p.Clears[stage-2] == 0 || rules.Validate() != nil || run.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	units, err := p.TeamUnits(rules)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	b, err := cardrpg.NewBattle(player.ID(), run.ID(), seq, stage, rules, units, p.BattleSeed(seq), nowUnixMilli)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if _, err := player.Stamina().Spend(rules.Stages[stage-1].Energy, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	p.ActiveRun = run.ID()
	p.Runs = append(p.Runs, cardrpg.Admission{Seq: seq, RunID: run.ID(), Stage: stage, ConfigHash: rules.Hash()})
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return run.ID(), saveCardBattle(run, b)
}

// saveCardBattle 在 Nest 锁内持久化下一回合期限；替换定时器 ID，使旧回调不能推进新回合。
func saveCardBattle(run ICardRunEntity, b cardrpg.Battle) error {
	if old := run.Dao().GetTurnTimer(); old != 0 {
		run.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(old)
		run.Dao().SetTurnTimer(0)
	}
	run.Dao().SetState(b.Encode())
	if b.State.Status == "running" {
		id := run.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(b.State.Deadline), runentity.TimerTurn, int64(b.NextSeq()), 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		run.Dao().SetTurnTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}

// 公网玩家入口只传已鉴权 PlayerID；不接收 ActorID=0 的 server-only 超时或敌方控制命令。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardTurn(run ICardRunEntity, actorID int64, command cardrpg.TurnCommand, nowUnixMilli int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if actorID != b.OwnerID || command.ActorID != actorID {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	before := len(b.Log)
	if err := b.Apply(command, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if len(b.Log) != before {
		if err := saveCardBattle(run, b); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
		}
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}

// 服务器敌方 AI 入口不暴露为客户端 endpoint；超时由持久 TimerComponent 驱动。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardEnemy(run ICardRunEntity, expected uint64, nowUnixMilli int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	before := len(b.Log)
	if err := b.Apply(cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: expected, Kind: "enemy"}, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if len(b.Log) != before {
		if err := saveCardBattle(run, b); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
		}
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}

// 同一 Run 与 Player 的奖励（金币经 wallet、尘经 bag）、首通、星级、任务事件（task 的 card.won）和领奖事实同事务，
// 不信任客户端报胜或奖励数值。“领过没有”是 Run 与开局账本里的 Claimed，金币用不留回执的 Wallet().Add。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardClaim(player view.PlayerEntity, run ICardRunEntity, nowUnixMilli int64) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	if b.OwnerID != player.ID() || b.RunID != run.ID() || b.AdmissionSeq == 0 || b.AdmissionSeq > uint64(len(p.Runs)) || b.State.Status == "running" {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	admission := &p.Runs[b.AdmissionSeq-1]
	if admission.RunID != b.RunID || admission.ConfigHash != b.ConfigHash || admission.Stage != b.Stage || admission.Claimed != b.Claimed {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	if b.Claimed {
		return cardView(player, p, nowUnixMilli), nil
	}
	if p.ActiveRun != run.ID() {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	if b.State.Status == "won" {
		stage := b.Rules.Stages[b.Stage-1]
		reward := stage.Gold
		if p.Clears[b.Stage-1] == 0 {
			reward += stage.FirstGold
		}
		if p.Wins >= cardrpg.ValueLimit {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		if err := applyEffects(player, cardrpg.Effects{Gold: reward, Dust: 1}, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
		}
		if err := player.Task().Report(CardWonEvent, 1, nowUnixMilli); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
		}
		p.Wins++
		p.Clears[b.Stage-1] = max(p.Clears[b.Stage-1], b.Stars())
	}
	admission.Claimed = true
	b.Claimed = true
	p.ActiveRun = 0
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	run.Dao().SetState(b.Encode())
	return cardView(player, p, nowUnixMilli), nil
}

// 读取也经正式锁边界，防止并发修改时直接从实体指针复制撕裂的视图。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardProfile(player view.PlayerEntity, nowUnixMilli int64) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	return cardView(player, p, nowUnixMilli), nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardBattle(run ICardRunEntity, actorID int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if b.OwnerID != actorID {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}
